description: Dataset for "Key role of network topology in water hammer in water distribution systems". is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Riccardo Vesipa, Luca Ridolfi (Polytechnic University of Turin). The characteristics of all the networks considered in this study are reported in three folders: Networks_L, that contains the networks with non-homogenous lengths; Networks_D, that contains the networks with non-homogenous diameters; Networks_LD, that contains the networks with non-homogenous lengths and diameters. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
